description: MainActivity.kt is the main activity source file for an Android app. It manages the home screen UI, including a banner carousel, navigation bar, and multiple content rails for categories like Trending, Action, Drama, etc. It handles network requests to fetch banner images and category items using OkHttp, parses JSON responses, and updates the UI accordingly.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages the home screen UI, fetches banners and category data over network, and handles user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up navigation, banner, and rails, and starts data fetching.

methods.name: setupPosterRail
methods.description: Configures a RecyclerView as a horizontal poster rail with spacing and assigns adapter.

methods.name: fetchAllRails
methods.description: Triggers fetches for all content categories with fallback URLs.

methods.name: setActiveNavHome
methods.description: Highlights the 'Home' navigation tab as active.

methods.name: setNavColors
methods.description: Updates the color of navigation items to indicate active/inactive state.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Shows or hides the banner loading indicator.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Controls visibility of the error container.

methods.name: setBanners
methods.description: Updates banner carousel with list of image URLs.

methods.name: parseBanners
methods.description: Parses banner URLs from JSON response.

methods.name: fetchBanners
methods.description: Fetches banner images from API endpoint, handles success and failure.

methods.name: fetchRail
methods.description: Fetches a specific content category with fallback URLs, updates adapter on success.

methods.name: attemptFetchRail
methods.description: Tries fetching from multiple fallback URLs recursively until success or exhaustion.

methods.name: parsePosters
methods.description: Parses list of poster items from JSON response; handles array or object wrapping.
